measurement_basis: completed subprocess wall times from session output; selection pipeline from persisted start timestamp to completion-file mtime; includes computation/data preparation, not code authoring or final verification

calculation.data: 32 F1-vs-A paired-color games plus C/E5 labels at measured 200ms budget
calculation.evaluation: 8 opening groups per candidate, 6 candidate epochs/run; up to 288 dev/final games
calculation.training: 45 expected or 60 maximum epochs per run; 30% and 40% tactical mixes; max two runs
